title: 有馬記念の後に・吹き続け、どこまでも

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Th-the winner is Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio wins the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio has made a miraculous comeback!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I suffered a sound defeat… Congratulations, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a view. Is this how you felt when you won the autumn Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It makes me wanna laugh out loud and shout, "I finally did it!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But you know, when you think about it—you surpassed your Emperor before I surpassed mine.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So, basically, my win today puts the score at 1-1! Which means our contest's not over yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And that means we've still gotta settle things!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's do it at our next race… 'Kay, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes… Our next race will be the one.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: After all, the wind never stops blowing.
